firm_data.firm_description: P&K Park manages high stakes litigation for international and domestic clients nationwide, focusing on efficient and targeted advocacy to meet client business goals. They specialize in complex product liability cases, offering comprehensive defense strategies.
notable_facts: Over 100 years of combined experience among attorneys.
Serve as national and regional counsel to major global companies.
Assist Korean companies with complex litigation and commercial transactions.

email.subject: AI for P&K Park, built for firms managing high-stakes product liability
email.body:
Hi Yong Jin,

Your team's track record defending complex product liability cases nationwide caught my attention, especially given the regulatory compliance demands you're juggling across international and domestic clients. That's exactly where we see firms like yours needing precision tools most.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
